name: Thick-Cut Filmstrip Crispy French Fries
whyItWorks: Broad ribbon-cut potatoes fried to an extra-crispy exterior trap substantial frying shortening. The crunchy edges and high oil load can scrape inflamed intestinal mucosa and speed up bowel transit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried Food Warning: Best kept to a few pieces during stable remission. Avoid during active symptom flares.
